```{r}
data_raw <- read_excel("mole crabs fixed swash and temp.xlsx") %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    water_temp = as.numeric(str_extract(water_temp, "[0-9.]+")),
    date = as.Date(date),
    year = factor(year(date))
  )
```

```{r}
clean_data <- data_raw %>%
  mutate(

    # ===========================
    # STANDARDIZE LOCATION
    # ===========================
    location = case_when(
      str_detect(tolower(location), "brighton|bluff") ~ "bluffs",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "south bath|bath ave") ~ "south_bath",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "deal|allenhurst|roosevelt") ~ "deal",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "ocean grove") ~ "ocean_grove",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "sandy hook") ~ "sandy_hook",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN WAVES
    # ===========================
    waves_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(tolower(waves_sm_med_large), "small|\\bsm\\b") ~ "Small",
      str_detect(tolower(waves_sm_med_large), "med") ~ "Medium",
      str_detect(tolower(waves_sm_med_large), "large|rough|3-5") ~ "Large",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN ZONE
    # ===========================
    zone = tolower(zone),
    zone = case_when(
      str_detect(zone, "bore")  ~ "bore",
      str_detect(zone, "swash|surf") ~ "swash",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN ENVIRONMENTAL NUMERIC VARIABLES
    # ===========================
    salinity = as.numeric(str_extract(salinity, "[0-9.]+")),
    do_mg_l_raw = as.numeric(str_extract(do_mg_l, "[0-9.]+")),
    air_temp_deg_c = as.numeric(str_extract(air_temp_deg_c, "[0-9.]+")),

    # ===========================
    # FIX DO
    # ===========================
    do_mg_l = case_when(
      do_mg_l_raw > 20 ~ NA_real_,
      do_mg_l_raw <= 0 ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ do_mg_l_raw
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN MOON PHASE
    # ===========================
    moon_phase_clean = tolower(moon_phase),
    moon_phase_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(moon_phase_clean, "full") ~ "Full",
      str_detect(moon_phase_clean, "first|waxing") ~ "Waxing",
      str_detect(moon_phase_clean, "last|waning") ~ "Waning",
      str_detect(moon_phase_clean, "quarter|quater") ~ "Quarter",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN TIDE STAGE
    # ===========================
    tide_clean = tolower(tide_stage),
    tide_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(tide_clean, "high") ~ "High",
      str_detect(tide_clean, "low|\\bl\\b") ~ "Low",
      str_detect(tide_clean, "rising|flood|incoming") ~ "Rising",
      str_detect(tide_clean, "falling|ebb") ~ "Falling",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN SKY
    # ===========================
    sky_clean = tolower(sky),
    sky_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(sky_clean, "clear|sun") ~ "Clear",
      str_detect(sky_clean, "part") ~ "Partly Cloudy",
      str_detect(sky_clean, "cloud") ~ "Cloudy",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN FOAM
    # ===========================
    foam_clean = tolower(foam_floatables_y_n),
    foam_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(foam_clean, "y|foam") ~ "Foam",
      str_detect(foam_clean, "n|none|little") ~ "No Foam",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN WATER CLARITY
    # ===========================
    water_clean = tolower(water_color_transparency),
    water_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(water_clean, "clear|transparent|high transparency") ~ "Clear",
      str_detect(water_clean, "murky|low transparency|dark|brown|grey|cloudy") ~ "Murky",
      str_detect(water_clean, "green|olive|yellow|blue") ~ "Moderate",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%

  # Remove helper column
  dplyr::select(-do_mg_l_raw) %>%

  # Keep valid locations only
  filter(!is.na(location)) %>%

  mutate(
  location = factor(location),
  year = factor(year, levels = sort(unique(year))),
  
  phase = case_when(
  year %in% c("2021","2022") ~ "Baseline",
  year == "2023" ~ "Disturbance",
  year == "2024" ~ "Collapse",
  year == "2025" ~ "Recovery",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
),

phase = factor(
  phase,
  levels = c("Baseline","Disturbance","Collapse","Recovery")
),
  
  waves_clean = factor(waves_clean, levels = c("Small","Medium","Large")),
  zone = factor(zone, levels = c("bore","swash")),
  moon_phase_clean = factor(moon_phase_clean,
                            levels = c("Waxing","Full","Waning","Quarter")),
  tide_clean = factor(tide_clean,
                      levels = c("Low","Rising","High","Falling")),
  sky_clean = factor(sky_clean,
                     levels = c("Clear","Partly Cloudy","Cloudy")),
  foam_clean = factor(foam_clean,
                      levels = c("No Foam","Foam")),
  water_clean = factor(water_clean,
                       levels = c("Clear","Moderate","Murky"))
) %>%
droplevels()
global_temp_mean <- mean(clean_data$water_temp, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------
# CREATE LONG FORMAT SIZE DATA
# ----------------------------------

size_data <- clean_data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    date,
    phase,
    water_temp,
    salinity,
    do_mg_l,
    air_temp_deg_c,
    waves_clean,
    location,
    year,
    zone,
    groin,            
    scoops,
    ct_2mm, ct_6mm, ct_12mm
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    ct_2mm  = as.numeric(ct_2mm),
    ct_6mm  = as.numeric(ct_6mm),
    ct_12mm = as.numeric(ct_12mm),
    
    # Clean  
    groin = case_when(
      groin %in% c("N","n") ~ "North",
      groin %in% c("S","s") ~ "South",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ct_2mm, ct_6mm, ct_12mm),
    names_to = "size_class",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    size_class = factor(
      size_class,
      levels = c("ct_2mm","ct_6mm","ct_12mm"),
      labels = c("Small (2mm)",
                 "Medium (6mm)",
                 "Large (12mm+)")
    ),
    count = ifelse(is.na(count), 0, count),
    
    zone = factor(zone, levels = c("bore","swash")),
    groin = factor(groin, levels = c("North","South")),
  ) %>%
  
  droplevels()
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------
# Quartiles by Year

quartiles_year <- size_data %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    q25 = quantile(count, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(count, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(quartiles_year)

# ----------------------------------
# Observed 2024 Decline
# ----------------------------------

decline_table <- clean_data %>%
  mutate(total = ct_2mm + ct_6mm + ct_12mm) %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2021","2022","2024")) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(mean_total = mean(total, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year,
              values_from = mean_total)

baseline_mean <- mean(c(decline_table$`2021`,
                        decline_table$`2022`))

decline <- 1 - (decline_table$`2024` / baseline_mean)

cat("Observed 2024 decline:",
    round(decline * 100, 1), "%\n")
# ----------------------------------
# Spatial Heterogeneity
# ----------------------------------

spatial_summary <- size_data %>%
  group_by(location) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_count = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    zero_prop = mean(count == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

print(spatial_summary)

# ----------------------------------
# Dispersion Metrics (NB Justification)
# ----------------------------------

mean_count <- mean(size_data$count, na.rm = TRUE)
var_count  <- var(size_data$count, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Overall mean:", mean_count, "\n")
cat("Overall variance:", var_count, "\n")
cat("Variance-to-Mean ratio:",
    var_count / mean_count, "\n")
```

```{r}
)
```

```{r}
# Clean labels

  sandy_hook  = "Sandy Hook",
  bluffs      = "Bluffs",

  deal        = "Deal",
  ocean_grove = "Ocean Grove"
)

    label_lon = lon - 0.025,
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# OBSERVED TEMPORAL TREND
# (CRABS PER SCOOP)
# ==========================================

observed_size <- size_data %>%
  group_by(year, size_class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_per_scoop = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(count, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    lower = mean_per_scoop - 1.96 * se,
    upper = mean_per_scoop + 1.96 * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year_num = as.numeric(as.character(year))
  )

ggplot(observed_size,
       aes(x = year_num,
           y = mean_per_scoop,
           color = size_class,
           fill = size_class,
           group = size_class)) +
  
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower,
                  ymax = upper),
              alpha = 0.15,
              color = NA) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.6) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = sort(unique(observed_size$year_num))
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Mean Abundance (Crabs per Scoop)",
    color = "Size Class",
    fill  = "Size Class",
    title = "Observed Temporal Abundance by Size Class"
  )
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------
# OBSERVED TEMPERATURE RELATIONSHIP
# (CRABS PER SCOOP)
# ----------------------------------

# ---- Add per-scoop standardization ----
size_data_temp <- size_data %>%
  filter(scoops > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    cps = count / scoops   # crabs per scoop
  )

# ---- Binned summary ----
obs_temp <- size_data_temp %>%
  mutate(temp_bin = round(water_temp * 2) / 2) %>%   # 0.5°C bins
  group_by(size_class, temp_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_cps = mean(cps, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(cps, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n >= 5)

ggplot() +
  
  # ---- Raw data points ----
  geom_jitter(
    data = size_data_temp,
    aes(x = water_temp,
        y = pmax(cps, 0.01),
        color = size_class),
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.25,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  
  # ---- SE ribbon ----
  geom_ribbon(
    data = obs_temp,
    aes(x = temp_bin,
        ymin = pmax(mean_cps - se, 0.01),
        ymax = mean_cps + se,
        fill = size_class,
        group = size_class),
    alpha = 0.18,
    color = NA
  ) +
  
  # ---- Mean line ----
  geom_line(
    data = obs_temp,
    aes(x = temp_bin,
        y = mean_cps,
        color = size_class,
        group = size_class),
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  
  # ---- Mean points ----
  geom_point(
    data = obs_temp,
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# BIOMASS DECLINE
# ==========================================

# ---- Compute biomass ----
biomass_zone <- size_data %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2021","2022","2023","2024","2025"),
         zone %in% c("bore","swash")) %>%
  mutate(
    size_mm = case_when(
      size_class == "Small (2mm)" ~ 2,
      size_class == "Medium (6mm)" ~ 6,
      size_class == "Large (12mm+)" ~ 12
    ),
    biomass_proxy = count * size_mm
  ) %>%
  group_by(zone, year) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_biomass = mean(biomass_proxy, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(biomass_proxy, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    lower = mean_biomass - 1.96 * se,
    upper = mean_biomass + 1.96 * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(year_num = as.numeric(as.character(year)))

# ---- Calculate recovery metrics ----
metrics <- biomass_zone %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2021","2024","2025")) %>%
  dplyr::select(zone, year, mean_biomass) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year,
              values_from = mean_biomass)

# ----------------------------------
# Phase-based biomass collapse
# ----------------------------------
# Collapse to phase
biomass_phase_means <- biomass_zone %>%
  mutate(
    phase = case_when(
      year %in% c("2021","2022") ~ "Baseline",
      year == "2023" ~ "Disturbance",
      year == "2024" ~ "Collapse",
      year == "2025" ~ "Recovery"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(zone, phase) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_biomass = mean(mean_biomass),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

baseline_vals <- biomass_phase_means %>%
  filter(phase == "Baseline")

collapse_vals <- biomass_phase_means %>%
  filter(phase == "Collapse")

collapse_pct <- round(
  100 * (
    1 -
    sum(collapse_vals$mean_biomass) /
    sum(baseline_vals$mean_biomass)
  ),
  0
)

# Zone-specific net recovery
metrics <- metrics %>%
  mutate(
    Net_Recovery = round((`2025` / `2021`) * 100, 0)
  )

swash_recovery <- metrics$Net_Recovery[metrics$zone == "swash"]
bore_recovery  <- metrics$Net_Recovery[metrics$zone == "bore"]

# ---- Disturbance Band ----
disturbance <- data.frame(
  xmin = 2023,
  xmax = 2024,
  ymin = min(biomass_zone$lower),
  ymax = max(biomass_zone$upper)
)

# ---- Plot ----
ggplot(biomass_zone,
       aes(x = year_num,
           y = mean_biomass,
           color = zone,
           fill = zone,
           group = zone)) +

  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower,
                  ymax = upper),
              alpha = 0.18,
              color = NA) +

  geom_line(linewidth = 2) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("bore" = "darkgreen",
                                "swash" = "limegreen")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("bore" = "darkgreen",
                               "swash" = "limegreen")) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2021,2022,2023,2024,2025)) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Mean Biomass (mm × count)",
    color = "Zone",
    fill = "Zone",
    title = "Zone-Specific Biomass Collapse and Divergent Recovery",
    subtitle = "Baseline biomass estimated at 2021-2022"
  )
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# BUILD INDEPENDENT SAMPLE-LEVEL DATASET
# (One row = one sampling event per zone)
# ==========================================

sample_struct <- clean_data %>%
  filter(location != "sandy_hook",
         scoops > 0) %>%
  
  group_by(date, location, zone, year, phase) %>%
  summarise(
    small  = sum(ct_2mm,  na.rm = TRUE),
    medium = sum(ct_6mm,  na.rm = TRUE),
    large  = sum(ct_12mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    total  = small + medium + large,
    
    water_temp = mean(water_temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Center temperature here (sample-level mean)
    water_temp_c = water_temp - global_temp_mean) %>%
  
  drop_na(phase, zone, water_temp)
# ==========================================
# GLOBAL DEMOGRAPHIC STRUCTURAL TEST
# ==========================================

demo_table <- sample_struct %>%
  group_by(phase) %>%
  summarise(
    Small  = sum(small),
    Medium = sum(medium),
    Large  = sum(large),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

rownames(demo_table) <- demo_table$phase
demo_table <- as.matrix(demo_table[, -1])
print(demo_table)

chi_test <- chisq.test(demo_table)

# Check expected counts explicitly
print(chi_test$expected)

# If any expected < 5, use simulated p-value
if(any(chi_test$expected < 5)){
  chi_test <- chisq.test(demo_table,
                         simulate.p.value = TRUE,
                         B = 10000)
  cat("Using simulated p-value due to small expected counts.\n")
}

print(chi_test)
n_total <- sum(demo_table)
min_dim <- min(dim(demo_table) - 1)

cramers_v <- sqrt(
  as.numeric(chi_test$statistic) /
  (n_total * min_dim)
)

cat("Cramer's V:", round(cramers_v,3), "\n")
# ==========================================
# MULTIVARIABLE JUVENILE MODEL
# ==========================================

juvenile_model <- glm(
  cbind(small, total - small) ~ phase + zone + 
                                water_temp_c,
  family = quasibinomial,
  data = sample_struct
)

summary(juvenile_model)

anova(juvenile_model, test = "F")
deviance(juvenile_model) / df.residual(juvenile_model)
# ==========================================
# MULTIVARIABLE ADULT MODEL
# ==========================================

adult_model <- glm(
  cbind(large, total - large) ~ phase + zone + 
                                water_temp_c,
  family = quasibinomial,
  data = sample_struct
)

summary(adult_model)

anova(adult_model, test = "F")

adult_zone_model <- glm(
  cbind(large, total - large) ~ phase * zone + 
                                water_temp_c,
  family = quasibinomial,
  data = sample_struct
)

anova(adult_model,
      adult_zone_model,
      test = "F")
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# STRUCTURAL BREAK – BASELINE vs DISTURBANCE
# ==========================================

# ---- 1. Create dominant size class per sample ----
sample_demo <- sample_struct %>%
  mutate(
    dominant_class = case_when(
  small == medium & medium == large ~ NA_character_,
  small  >= medium & small  >= large ~ "Small",
  medium >= small  & medium >= large ~ "Medium",
  large  >= small  & large  >= medium ~ "Large",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)
  )

# ---- 2. Collapse to 2 phases (Baseline vs Disturbance) ----
sample_break <- sample_demo %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2021","2022","2023","2024")) %>%
  mutate(
    phase = ifelse(
      year %in% c("2021","2022"),
      "Baseline",
      "Disturbance"
    ),
    phase = factor(phase,
                   levels = c("Baseline","Disturbance"))
  )

# ---- 3. Build contingency table ----
demo_table <- table(sample_break$phase,
                    sample_break$dominant_class)

print(demo_table)

# ---- 4. Check expected counts ----
chi_test <- chisq.test(demo_table)

print(chi_test)
print(chi_test$expected)

# ---- 5. If expected counts < 5, use simulated p-value ----
if(any(chi_test$expected < 5)) {
  chi_test <- chisq.test(demo_table,
                         simulate.p.value = TRUE,
                         B = 10000)
  cat("\nUsing simulated p-value (small sample correction)\n")
  print(chi_test)
}

# ---- 6. Compute Cramér’s V ----
n_total <- sum(demo_table)

min_dim <- min(nrow(demo_table) - 1,
               ncol(demo_table) - 1)

cramers_v <- sqrt(
  as.numeric(chi_test$statistic) /
  (n_total * min_dim)
)

cat("\nCramer's V (Baseline vs Disturbance):",
    round(cramers_v, 3), "\n")
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------
# Baseline Ontogenetic Partitioning
# (Contingency-table version for effect size)
# ------------------------------------------

baseline_struct <- sample_struct %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2021","2022"))

# Adult dominant vs zone
baseline_struct <- baseline_struct %>%
  mutate(adult_dominant = large > medium & large > small)

partition_table <- table(
  baseline_struct$zone,
  baseline_struct$adult_dominant
)

chi_part <- chisq.test(partition_table)

print(chi_part)

n_part <- sum(partition_table)

cramers_v_part <- sqrt(
  as.numeric(chi_part$statistic) /
    (n_part * (min(dim(partition_table)) - 1))
)

cramers_v_part <- round(cramers_v_part, 2)

cat("\nCramer's V =", cramers_v_part, "\n")
```

```{r}
analysis_data <- size_data %>%
  filter(location != "sandy_hook") %>%
  filter(scoops > 0) %>%

    salinity_c = salinity - mean(salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    do_c = do_mg_l - mean(do_mg_l, na.rm = TRUE),
    air_temp_c = air_temp_deg_c - mean(air_temp_deg_c, na.rm = TRUE),
    zone = factor(zone, levels = c("bore","swash")),
    groin = factor(groin, levels = c("North","South")),
    year = factor(year)
  ) %>%
  drop_na(count, scoops, size_class, location, year) %>%
  droplevels()

analysis_data$year <- relevel(analysis_data$year, ref = "2021")
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# PRIMARY MODEL
# ==========================================
nb_full_interaction <- glmmTMB(
  count ~ log_scoops + location +
           size_class * zone * phase +
           water_temp_c * phase * zone +
           size_class * zone * water_temp_c
           + (1 | date),
  family = nbinom2,
  data = analysis_data
)

# Extract temperature-related coefficients
coefs <- fixef(nb_full_interaction)$cond
vc    <- vcov(nb_full_interaction)$cond

grep("water_temp", names(coefs), value = TRUE)
coefs[grep("water_temp", names(coefs))]
summary(nb_full_interaction)
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# THERMAL FILTERING BY PHASE × ZONE × SIZE
# Fully marginal (+1°C effect)
# ==========================================

# Copy modeling data
data0 <- analysis_data
data1 <- analysis_data

# Set temperature difference
data0$water_temp_c <- 0
data1$water_temp_c <- 1

# Population-level predictions (exclude random date effect)
pred0 <- predict(
  nb_full_interaction,
  newdata = data0,
  type = "response",
  re.form = NA
)

pred1 <- predict(
  nb_full_interaction,
  newdata = data1,
  type = "response",
  re.form = NA
)

analysis_data$pred0 <- pred0
analysis_data$pred1 <- pred1

thermal_full <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(phase, zone, size_class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean0 = mean(pred0),
    mean1 = mean(pred1),
    IRR_per_1C = mean1 / mean0,
    Percent_Change = round((IRR_per_1C - 1) * 100, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(thermal_full)
# ==========================================
# BASELINE THERMAL FILTERING TEXT
# ==========================================

baseline_thermal <- thermal_full %>%
  filter(phase == "Baseline")

format_baseline_text <- function(df){
  
  small  <- df %>% filter(size_class == "Small (2mm)") %>% pull(Percent_Change)
  medium <- df %>% filter(size_class == "Medium (6mm)") %>% pull(Percent_Change)
  large  <- df %>% filter(size_class == "Large (12mm+)") %>% pull(Percent_Change)
  
  paste0(
    "Small: ", ifelse(small > 0, "+", ""), small, "%<BR/>",
    "Medium: ", ifelse(medium > 0, "+", ""), medium, "%<BR/>",
    "Large: ", ifelse(large > 0, "+", ""), large, "%"
  )
}

baseline_swash_text <- format_baseline_text(
  baseline_thermal %>% filter(zone == "swash")
)

baseline_bore_text <- format_baseline_text(
  baseline_thermal %>% filter(zone == "bore")
)
# ==========================================
# DISTURBANCE-PERIOD THERMAL FILTERING
# (Average of Disturbance + Collapse)
# ==========================================

disturbance_thermal <- thermal_full %>%
  
  filter(phase %in% c("Disturbance","Collapse")) %>%
  
  left_join(
  analysis_data %>%
    distinct(date, phase) %>%
    count(phase, name = "n_phase"),
  by = "phase"
) %>%
  
  group_by(zone, size_class) %>%
  summarise(
    IRR_avg = weighted.mean(IRR_per_1C, w = n_phase),
    Percent_Change_avg = round((IRR_avg - 1) * 100, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(disturbance_thermal)
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# MODEL-BASED TEMPORAL TREND

# ---- Population-level fitted values ----
analysis_data$fit_link <- predict(
  nb_full_interaction,
  type = "link",
  re.form = NA
)

analysis_data$fit_resp <- exp(analysis_data$fit_link)

# ---- Summarise by year × size class ----
model_year <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(year, size_class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_fit = mean(fit_resp),
    se = sd(fit_resp) / sqrt(n()),
    lower = mean_fit - 1.96 * se,
    upper = mean_fit + 1.96 * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year_num = as.numeric(as.character(year))
  )

# ==========================================
# Baseline decline

  filter(year %in% c("2021","2022")) %>%
  summarise(mean_base = mean(mean_fit)) %>%

  pull(mean_2024)

  x = 2024,

                 model_decline_pct,

# ==========================================
# Plot

       aes(x = year_num,
           y = mean_fit,
           color = size_class,
           fill = size_class,
           group = size_class)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower,
                  ymax = upper),

            aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),

  scale_fill_manual(values = crab_colors) +

  ) +

  )
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# RECREATE ZERO MODEL DATASET (CLEAN)
# ==========================================

zero_data <- clean_data %>%
  
  # Match modeling exclusions
  filter(location != "sandy_hook",
         scoops > 0) %>%
  
  mutate(
    phase = factor(phase,
               levels = c("Baseline","Disturbance","Collapse","Recovery")),
    
    # Total abundance per sampling event
    total_count = ct_2mm + ct_6mm + ct_12mm,
    
    # Binary zero indicator
    zero_flag = ifelse(total_count == 0, 1, 0),
    # Zone factor
    zone = factor(zone,
                  levels = c("bore","swash")),
    
    # Log effort
    log_scoops = log(scoops),
    
    # Center temperature
    water_temp_c = water_temp - global_temp_mean
  ) %>%
  
  # Remove rows missing key variables
  drop_na(phase, zone, water_temp)

# Quick structural check
table(zero_data$phase, zero_data$zone, zero_data$zero_flag)
summary(zero_data$zero_flag)
nrow(zero_data)

# ==========================================
# ZERO PROBABILITY MODEL (Final Version)
# Firth logistic to handle separation
# ==========================================

zero_model_firth <- logistf(
  zero_flag ~ phase + zone + log_scoops + water_temp_c,
  data = zero_data
)

summary(zero_model_firth)

# Odds ratios with profile CIs
zero_or_table <- exp(cbind(
  OR  = coef(zero_model_firth),
  LCL = confint(zero_model_firth)[,1],
  UCL = confint(zero_model_firth)[,2]
))

print(zero_or_table)
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# SIZE-SPECIFIC ZERO MODEL (FINAL VERSION)
# ==========================================
# ------------------------------------------
# 1. Build size-specific zero dataset
#    (one row = one sample × size class)
# ------------------------------------------

zero_data_size <- size_data %>%
  
  filter(location != "sandy_hook",
         scoops > 0) %>%
  
  mutate(
    
    # Zero indicator per size class
    zero_flag = ifelse(count == 0, 1, 0),
    zone = factor(
      zone,
      levels = c("bore","swash")
    ),
    
    size_class = factor(
      size_class,
      levels = c("Small (2mm)",
                 "Medium (6mm)",
                 "Large (12mm+)")
    ),
    
    # Effort + centered temperature
    log_scoops = log(scoops),
    water_temp_c = water_temp - global_temp_mean
    
  ) %>%
  
  drop_na(phase, zone, size_class, water_temp_c)

# Confirm structure
table(zero_data_size$phase,
      zero_data_size$zone,
      zero_data_size$size_class)

# ------------------------------------------
# 2. Fit Firth logistic regression
#    (All 2-way interactions, no 3-way)
# ------------------------------------------

zero_model_size <- logistf(
  formula = zero_flag ~
            phase * size_class +
            zone  * size_class +
            phase * zone +
            log_scoops +
            water_temp_c,
  data = zero_data_size
)

summary(zero_model_size)

# ------------------------------------------
# 3. Add model-predicted probabilities
#    (Predictions on observed data)
# ------------------------------------------

zero_data_size$pred_zero <- predict(
  zero_model_size,
  type = "response"
)

# ------------------------------------------
# 4. Summarize predicted probabilities
#    by phase × zone × size class
# ------------------------------------------

pred_summary_size <- zero_data_size %>%
  group_by(phase, zone, size_class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_pred_zero = mean(pred_zero),
    se = sd(pred_zero) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(pred_summary_size)

# ------------------------------------------
# 5. Optional: Odds ratios with profile CIs
# ------------------------------------------

zero_or_table <- exp(cbind(
  OR  = coef(zero_model_size),
  LCL = confint(zero_model_size)[,1],
  UCL = confint(zero_model_size)[,2]
))

print(zero_or_table)

# ==========================================
# ZERO-INFLATED NB ROBUSTNESS CHECK
# ==========================================
nb_zi_model <- glmmTMB(
  count ~ log_scoops +
           size_class * zone * phase +
           water_temp_c * phase * zone +
           size_class * zone * water_temp_c +
           location +
           (1 | date),
  ziformula = ~ phase,
  family = nbinom2,
  data = analysis_data
)
cat("\n===== ZERO-INFLATED MODEL COMPARISON =====\n")

AIC_nb  <- AIC(nb_full_interaction)
AIC_zi  <- AIC(nb_zi_model)

cat("Standard NB AIC:", AIC_nb, "\n")
cat("Zero-Inflated NB AIC:", AIC_zi, "\n")

if(AIC_zi + 2 < AIC_nb){
  cat("⚠ Zero-inflated model improves fit.\n")
} else {
  cat("✓ No strong evidence for zero inflation.\n")
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# FINAL MODEL DIAGNOSTIC SUITE
# (Run after all models are fit)
# ============================================================

cat("\n=============================\n")
cat("MODEL DIAGNOSTIC CHECKS\n")
cat("=============================\n\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. BINOMIAL OVERDISPERSION CHECK
# ------------------------------------------------------------
check_overdisp <- function(model, name){
  ratio <- deviance(model) / df.residual(model)
  cat("\n---", name, "---\n")
  cat("Dispersion ratio:", round(ratio, 3), "\n")
  if(ratio > 1.5){
    cat("⚠ Potential overdispersion detected.\n")
  } else {
    cat("✓ No serious overdispersion.\n")
  }
}

if(exists("global_model")) check_overdisp(global_model, "Global Demographic Model")
if(exists("adult_model")) check_overdisp(adult_model, "Adult Structure Model")
if(exists("juvenile_model")) check_overdisp(juvenile_model, "Juvenile Structure Model")
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. NEGATIVE BINOMIAL DISPERSION ADEQUACY
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if(exists("nb_full_interaction")){
cat("\n--- Negative Binomial Dispersion ---\n")

dispersion <- sigma(nb_full_interaction)

cat("NB dispersion (sigma):", round(dispersion, 4), "\n")

if(dispersion < 0.2){
  cat("⚠ Very strong overdispersion (small dispersion).\n")
} else {
  cat("✓ Dispersion parameter reasonable.\n")
}}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. SINGULARITY CHECK
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if(exists("nb_full_interaction")){
  cat("\n--- Rank Deficiency Check ---\n")
 mm <- model.matrix(
  ~ log_scoops +
    size_class * zone * phase +
    water_temp_c * phase * zone +
    size_class * zone * water_temp_c +
    location,
  data = analysis_data
)
  qr_rank <- qr(mm)$rank
  full_rank <- ncol(mm)
  cat("Model rank:", qr_rank, "of", full_rank, "\n")
  if(qr_rank < full_rank){
    cat("⚠ Model matrix is rank deficient (missing combinations).\n")
  } else {
    cat("✓ No rank deficiency detected.\n")
  }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. DATE CLUSTERING TEST (Need Random Effects?)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if(exists("analysis_data")){
  
  nb_fixed_glmmTMB <- glmmTMB(
  count ~ log_scoops +
      size_class * phase +
      zone * phase +
      water_temp_c * phase +
      size_class * zone * water_temp_c +
      location,
  family = nbinom2,
  data = analysis_data
)
  
  cat("\n--- Date Clustering Test ---\n")
  print(anova(nb_fixed_glmmTMB, nb_full_interaction))
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. RESIDUAL DIAGNOSTICS
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if(exists("nb_full_interaction")){
  
  cat("\n--- Residual Diagnostics ---\n")
  
  pearson_resid <- residuals(nb_full_interaction, type="pearson")
  fitted_vals <- fitted(nb_full_interaction)
  
  cat("Residual mean:", round(mean(pearson_resid),3), "\n")
  cat("Residual SD:", round(sd(pearson_resid),3), "\n")
  
  if(abs(mean(pearson_resid)) < 0.1){
    cat("✓ Residuals centered appropriately.\n")
  } else {
    cat("⚠ Residuals not centered at zero.\n")
  }
  
  cor_rf <- cor(pearson_resid, fitted_vals)
  cat("Residual vs fitted correlation:", round(cor_rf,3), "\n")
  
  if(abs(cor_rf) < 0.2){
    cat("✓ No major pattern in residuals.\n")
  } else {
    cat("⚠ Possible model misspecification.\n")
  }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. MULTICOLLINEARITY (VIF)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
nb_additive <- glm.nb(
  count ~ log_scoops +
          water_temp_c +
          size_class +
          location +
          zone +
          year,
  data = analysis_data
)
if(exists("nb_additive")){
  cat("\n--- Variance Inflation Factors ---\n")
  vif_vals <- try(car::vif(nb_additive), silent=TRUE)
  if(!inherits(vif_vals, "try-error")){
    print(vif_vals)}}

cat("\n=============================\n")
cat("END DIAGNOSTICS\n")
cat("=============================\n")
```

```{r disturbance_clock, eval=knitr::is_html_output()}
mean_size_df <- size_data %>%

      size_class == "Small (2mm)" ~ 2,

      size_class == "Large (12mm+)" ~ 12
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_size = sum(count * size_mm) / sum(count),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

  mean(mean_size_df$mean_size[mean_size_df$year %in% c("2021","2022")]),
  1
)

mean_size_2025 <- round(
  mean_size_df$mean_size[mean_size_df$year == "2025"],
  1
)

size_decline <- round(
  100 * (1 - mean_size_2025 / mean_size_baseline),
  1
)

# =====================================================

  exp(coef(zero_model_firth)["phaseDisturbance"]),
  2
)

  filter(location != "sandy_hook",

      size_class == "Small (2mm)" ~ 2,
      size_class == "Medium (6mm)" ~ 6,
      size_class == "Large (12mm+)" ~ 12
    ),

  ) %>%
```
